headlines.title: 4 Dividend Kings Retirees Can Buy and Hold Forever: Safe Income for the Next 60 Years
headlines.summary: Four Dividend Kings have raised their payouts for decades, but a closer look at their cash flows reveals one payout hanging by a thread while another faces a looming tax battle that could shake retiree income.

headlines.title: PepsiCo slashes valuation of Poppi bonus payouts as growth slows
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- PepsiCo Inc (NASDAQ:PEP) has significantly lowered its valuation of potential bonus payments associated with its acquisition of prebiotic soda brand Poppi, signaling that the unit is missing the growth benchmarks required to trigger the earnout.

headlines.title: Is Coca-Cola Stock Worth More Than Its Competitors?
headlines.summary: Coca-Cola (KO) retains more of each sales dollar as operating profit than any of its five designated peers, a group ranging from PepsiCo to Monster Beverage. The company has also delivered the highest stock return among these six companies over the past year. Yet investors currently pay more per dollar of earnings for three of those peers. So what do those three rivals offer that Coca-Cola does not.

headlines.title: Is PepsiCo’s Euro Bond Raise and Outlook Cut Altering The Investment Case For PepsiCo (PEP)?
headlines.summary: In early October 2026, PepsiCo completed two euro-denominated fixed-rate bond offerings totaling about €998.89 million, issued as callable, senior unsecured notes with coupons of 3.750% due October 16, 2029, and 4.250% due October 16, 2035, alongside reporting higher third-quarter and nine‑month sales and earnings versus a year earlier.

description: PepsiCo, Inc. engages in the manufacture, marketing, distribution, and sale of various beverages and convenient foods worldwide. The company operates through six segments: PepsiCo Foods North America; PepsiCo Beverages North America; International Beverages Franchise; Europe, Middle East and Africa; Latin America Foods; and Asia Pacific Foods. It offers cereals, chips, dips, granola bars, oatmeal, pasta, rice, and syrups and mixes; refrigerated dips and spreads; beverage concentrates, fountain syrups, and finished goods; and ready-to-drink tea and coffee products. The company also provides SodaStream sparkling water makers and related products, as well as various dairy products under the Agusha, Chudo, and Domik v Derevne brands. It serves wholesale and other distributors, foodservice customers, grocery stores, drug stores, convenience stores, discount/dollar stores, mass merchandisers, membership stores, hard discounters, e-commerce retailers and authorized independent bottlers, and others through a network of direct-store-delivery, customer warehouse, and distributor networks, as well as directly to consumers through e-commerce platforms and retailers. PepsiCo, Inc. was founded in 1898 and is based in Purchase, New York.
